name: Accessible-domain state normal form
proposed_conclusion: A theory package admits a typed operational-domain record separating expressible, present, exposed, recoverable, admissible, reachable, and occurrent statuses; converses require explicit witnesses.
proof_obligations: ["Define equality and scope change for domain states.", "Prove non-collapse finite models for each adjacent status.", "Relate the record to inherited quotient and access data without replacing P1–P6."]

name: Lawful admission transition system
proposed_conclusion: Admission, expiry, revocation, retraction, and rollback are typed transitions whose execution requires source, budget, guard, and audit witnesses distinct from rule text.
proof_obligations: ["Give transition typing and ledger-update laws.", "Separate soundness, executability, reachability, firing, and occurrence.", "Specify lawful rollback without erasing history."]

name: Bootstrap obstruction theorem
proposed_conclusion: A closed admission regime with no admitted seed and no reachable generator has no lawful first extension.
proof_obligations: ["Define first-extension and closed-regime hypotheses exactly.", "Prove the finite theorem and isolate infinite escape routes.", "Distinguish neutral provisioning from outcome-rigging."]

name: Neutral seed and provisioning certificate
proposed_conclusion: A seed receives neutral-provisioning status only when its source, symmetry, task-blindness, preregistration, and control coordinates are recorded before use.
proof_obligations: ["Define admissible seed equivalence classes.", "Prove that post-hoc or source-laundered stocking fails the certificate.", "Provide finite positive and rigged-seed controls."]

name: Common-origin non-transfer law
proposed_conclusion: Common origin, common carrier, or common instrument does not entail shared access, source independence, or an independence-sensitive join.
proof_obligations: ["Construct same-source/no-shared-access models.", "State extra witnesses sufficient for each stronger conclusion.", "Block total-lens-to-partial-domain transfer."]

name: Prospective commitment certificate
proposed_conclusion: A prospective commitment is a timestamped, preregistered, finite-budget rule that fixes later admission conditions before the target evidence is observed.
proof_obligations: ["Define certified temporal precedence without assuming one global clock.", "Prove retrospective predicates cannot discharge the same certificate.", "Specify expiry and unused-budget accounting."]

name: Join-entry record normal form
proposed_conclusion: Entry to the join calculus requires parent packages, typed contact surface, witnessed contact or pending status, source and licensing ledgers, budget, obstruction semantics, and an append-only audit record.
proof_obligations: ["Prove field sufficiency for retrospective verification.", "Separate pending, failed, obstructed, and completed statuses.", "Show omission of source/contact/budget fields permits false positives."]

name: Join existence and obstruction status calculus
proposed_conclusion: Within a declared finite interface family, join attempts are classified as no contact, contact, common refinement, composite, strict join, typed obstruction, or coverage-qualified non-interaction.
proof_obligations: ["Prove statuses disjoint or state permitted overlaps.", "Give source, compatibility, gluing, retention, novelty, budget, and temporal obstruction witnesses.", "Do not claim completeness beyond the declared family."]

name: Strict join certificate and anti-product witness
proposed_conclusion: A strict join requires composite objecthood, recoverable parent retention, and a distinction or operation that does not factor through either parent or their declared mere product/common refinement.
proof_obligations: ["Define the comparison baseline and anti-product witness.", "Prove relabeling, coarsening, and scheduling controls fail strictness.", "Keep objecthood, novelty, and directionality certificates separate."]

name: Source-independence gate
proposed_conclusion: Independence-sensitive join claims require a source/ancestry witness separate from behavioral nonfactorization; native and bridged records retain their source types.
proof_obligations: ["Define ancestry equivalence and honest bridging.", "Prove same-lineage re-expression fails independence credit.", "Separate source independence from causal independence."]

name: Join budget and payment ledger
proposed_conclusion: A join ledger prices interface access, parent retention, joint novelty, observer/instrument occupancy, cross-costs, and explicit refunds; zero total cost requires a certified zero-cost channel.
proof_obligations: ["Define currencies without assuming one scalar currency.", "Prove finite live-join bounds under stated capacity hypotheses.", "Expose hidden observer subsidies and post-failure refunds."]

name: Enablement record and attribution calculus
proposed_conclusion: Enablement records identify the operation made available, its source, execution witness, budget, target effect, and attribution to theorist, carrier, peer theory, observer, environment, endogenous system, or mixed source.
proof_obligations: ["Define enablement independently of descent, containment, sufficiency, and causation.", "Give mixed-provenance and observer-certified cases.", "Prove attribution is stable under honest bridge refinement."]

name: Endogenous enablement criterion
proposed_conclusion: Enablement is endogenous only when the system carries, reaches, executes, and audits the enabling generator within the declared boundary and pays its resource costs.
proof_obligations: ["State carried-generator and boundary conditions.", "Prove theorist-triggered and hidden-observer cases fail.", "Relate to inherited repair-generator reachability without overidentifying cognition."]

name: Birth/contact-surface classification
proposed_conclusion: Layer birth is classified by who performs closure, what new object survives, whether participants are created or only related, and whether the birth occurs at or through a contact surface.
proof_obligations: ["Reconcile inherited birth classes before adding cases.", "Provide finite reachability requirements for each class.", "Separate undergoing closure from performing it."]

name: Typed transmission and descent-fidelity law
proposed_conclusion: Upward, downward, and peer transmission are typed maps with explicit payload, loss, ambiguity, and source records; downward selection cannot create lower-carrier facts absent from the lower carrier.
proof_obligations: ["Define transmission types and descent-fidelity witnesses.", "Prove direction-specific invariants and countermodels.", "Separate structural selection from a top-down causal channel."]

name: Peer contact and transport without join
proposed_conclusion: Certified content may become available to a peer through a typed contact/transport record without forming a joint theory; destination ownership and provenance remain explicit.
proof_obligations: ["Classify rendezvous, mediation, sequential transport, shared carrier, and shared budget.", "Prove contact-before-connection under local-interface hypotheses.", "Distinguish sequential composition from interaction of composites."]

name: Interaction-order residue and holonomy
proposed_conclusion: For three or more admitted interactions, inequivalent legal orderings define a route residue relative to a declared predictive quotient; nonzero residue is interaction holonomy, not by itself directionality.
proof_obligations: ["Define bracketing/order comparison on one typed target.", "Prove finite examples and confluence controls.", "Add a separate drive/null certificate for arrow claims."]

name: Admission confluence and seed-dependence law
proposed_conclusion: Distinct lawful admission/refinement routes are confluent exactly under declared critical-pair and audit-equivalence conditions; otherwise fixed points may depend on route or initial seed partition.
proof_obligations: ["State finite critical-pair conditions.", "Construct nonconfluent and seed-dependent controls.", "Separate terminal equality from predictive equivalence."]

name: Access/join residual and obstruction-dissolution ledger
proposed_conclusion: Inaccessible, unadmitted, expired, failed, or join-created distinctions remain typed residuals; ascent, peer join, refinement, or declared termination may discharge them, with cross-terms recorded explicitly.
proof_obligations: ["Define residual addition and cross-term conditions.", "Construct peer-removable and join-manufactured needles.", "Prove no silent deletion under scope changes."]

name: Bridge and semantic-withdrawal discipline
proposed_conclusion: Every imported law or interaction claim carries source/target maps, hypotheses, audit path, nonclaims, and append-only failure or withdrawal records; citations alone never license transport.
proof_obligations: ["Reuse the Step-2 bridge schema as VII's own citation rule.", "Specify paraphrase and downstream-dependency sweeps for withdrawal.", "Retain failed bridges as first-class records."]

name: Reachability, guard activity, and horizon law
proposed_conclusion: Lawfulness, non-vacuity, reachability, firing, and occurrence are separate; finite-horizon non-occurrence licenses only horizon-qualified conclusions unless reachability and guard power are independently established.
proof_obligations: ["Define guard-activity and reachability witnesses.", "Prove sound-unreachable and reachable-nonoccurring models.", "State exhaustive closed-family conditions for stronger negatives."]

name: Exposure, recoverability, admissibility, and rigidity calculus
proposed_conclusion: Determination, exposure, recoverability, and admissibility are independent interface coordinates; exposure overread and spurious rigidity occur when distinctions or constraints are supplied by operations absent from the substrate.
proof_obligations: ["Give auxiliary-recovery equivalence conditions.", "Construct same-determination/different-exposure models.", "Separate genuine rigidity from wrong-interface overconstraint."]

name: Negative-result quantifier discipline
proposed_conclusion: The force of a negative result is fixed by its quantifiers and search-family closure: a point null, bounded search, exhaustive finite family, and theorem-grade impossibility have distinct conclusions.
proof_obligations: ["Encode the four evidence grades in the claim schema.", "Prove the finite exhaustive inference rule.", "Require escape-route and family-closure records."]

name: Claim-grade and normative-specification discipline
proposed_conclusion: VII statements preserve theorem/schema/calibration/conjecture/philosophy grades, label necessary and sufficient conditions explicitly, and are judged against normative specifications rather than illustrative examples.
proof_obligations: ["Carry grade fields into every candidate and theorem ledger.", "Run red-line and nonclaim scans before drafting.", "Preserve P039 and P040/P058 source/version limitations."]

name: Two-Theory World detector contract
proposed_conclusion: Every interaction law is paired with append-only evidence, signal, null, falsifier, same-source/no-contact/scheduling/relabeling controls, and asymmetric false-positive costs in a finite reference world.
proof_obligations: ["Implement deterministic scenario evaluation.", "Freeze expected statuses before later experiments.", "Treat the lab as an assay, never a substitute for proof."]

name: Categorical reduction decision
proposed_conclusion: Reduction of the VII join to product, pullback, pushout, or another categorical construction remains conditional on an explicit category of packages, interfaces, and admissible morphisms.
proof_obligations: ["Define the category and universal property before reduction claims.", "Find a finite countermodel to unconditional reduction.", "Prove only special-case equivalences first."]

name: Enablement-chain composition law
proposed_conclusion: Enablement relations compose only when source types, execution witnesses, budgets, and residual obligations compose; chain order may carry holonomy or accumulated debt.
proof_obligations: ["Define composability and accumulated ledgers.", "Prove a finite associative special case and non-associative control.", "Separate composed enablement from transitive causation."]

name: Primitive-operation algebra readiness criterion
proposed_conclusion: A generators-and-relations algebra is deferred until primitive operations, equivalences, composition domains, and categorical semantics are fixed and proved nonredundant.
proof_obligations: ["List candidate generators and dependency risks.", "State the evidence gate for reopening the algebra program.", "Prevent P1–P6 from being repurposed as unproved generators."]

name: Observer and instrument occupancy law
proposed_conclusion: An observer or instrument using bounded shared capacity cannot certify native/endogenous formation while omitting its occupancy, source role, or cost from the system ledger.
proof_obligations: ["Define occupancy and shared-capacity accounting.", "Prove hidden-occupancy false-positive model.", "State certified zero-cost and external-observer escape routes."]

name: Parent refinement, retention, and join descent
proposed_conclusion: A join certificate records which parent objects, laws, and source identities remain recoverable; parent refinement may preserve, strengthen, weaken, or destroy the join depending on compatibility and strictness witnesses.
proof_obligations: ["Define parent-retention maps and refinement transport.", "Construct join-destruction and partial-retention models.", "Prove no silent full-retention claim after erasure."]

name: Contact-degree conservation decision
proposed_conclusion: No conserved contact degree is assumed; candidate quantities must first be defined, shown invariant under declared joins, and separated from bookkeeping artifacts.
proof_obligations: ["Inventory plausible invariants from inherited currencies and residuals.", "Construct nonconservation controls.", "Require an exact conservation theorem before naming a degree."]

name: Interaction arrow, irreversibility, and cross-time contact
proposed_conclusion: Arrow or irreversibility claims require a drive/path-asymmetry certificate and null-versus-driven controls distinct from order residue; cross-time contact uses explicit synchronization or order witnesses rather than assumed simultaneity.
proof_obligations: ["Define drive and reversal tests.", "Give holonomy-zero-arrow and driven controls.", "Specify contact across partially ordered or incommensurable clocks."]

name: Coverage-qualified certified non-interaction
proposed_conclusion: Certified non-interaction is a positive, family-scoped result only when contact channels, detector power, budget, horizon, and search-family closure are recorded and all admissible cases are exhausted or theoremically excluded.
proof_obligations: ["Define coverage and power certificates.", "Separate no evidenced contact from certified non-interaction.", "State exact escape routes outside the family."]

name: Enablement without descent separation theorem
proposed_conclusion: There exist lawful enablement records in which an operation becomes available and is load-bearing while no factorization/descent of the enabled object through the enabler exists; enablement may also be necessary but insufficient.
proof_obligations: ["Construct finite witnesses for both separations.", "Specify the no-descent audit and insufficiency alternatives.", "Block causal overstatement."]

name: No-free-join and self-bootstrap no-go family
proposed_conclusion: A join cannot create the first capability required to execute itself, manufacture strict joint information by relabeling, or receive positive-cost join credit without a paid or certified zero-cost channel.
proof_obligations: ["Separate bootstrap, novelty, and payment hypotheses.", "Prove finite cases and list external-seed/zero-cost escape routes.", "Avoid conflating the family with one universal no-go."]

name: Join-created obstruction and needle law
proposed_conclusion: A join may dissolve parent obstructions yet create new cross-term needles localized to the composite interface; the ledger must distinguish inherited, dissolved, and newly generated residuals.
proof_obligations: ["Construct a finite join-created needle.", "Define cross-term provenance and discharge conditions.", "Prove relabeling does not count as new obstruction."]
